title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: Implemented in Ireland by Trócaire, the ICSP programme works towards the goal that educators have increased confidence in using GCE methodologies with their learners and understand the links between GCE and their relevant curricula in early years, primary, post-primary and youth education. This objective focuses on existing GCE data and learning informing the learning support and learning products for educators and the GCE programmes for young people, through a data driven approach to programme quality. Key activities include ensuring robust and effective data gathering and analysis by having MEAL systems in place, which guarantee reflection and learning is constantly informing the programme. The principal focus of this outcome is the provision of quality, lifelong GCE learning opportunities to empower active global citizens
